name: Overview Metrics, Timeline, Cross-domain Projections
transaction_boundaries: Overview owns no authoritative mutation and executes no domain command.
Each composed Overview response is read from one LLD-01 SQLite read snapshot shared by all provider reads so cross-domain values are internally consistent.
No persistent Overview cache/materialized table exists in Beta 1.0; any client query retention is disposable presentation state and never authorizes mutation.
Communication summary composition consumes only exact owner-scoped target refs and LLD-09 CommunicationSummaryProvider within the same read snapshot; no Communication body/table authority is copied.
Report generation remains LLD-06 authority and takes its own consistent report snapshot; Overview only navigates to that command surface.
failure_modes: unexpected mandatory-provider query failure fails the Overview request visibly rather than substituting zero or stale success
typed owner coverage unknown/partial/stale/unconfigured remains a successful explicit projection state
invalid customer scope or period fails before provider reads
communication target stream or entity-summary failure fails visibly instead of returning a partial/zero summary
narrative template mismatch omits no underlying fact silently and fails construction tests
Resolved Status Date is never requested or synthesized
review_evidence: HLD-12 read-projection authority imported without dashboard-owned operational state.
Daily/Weekly/Monthly period boundaries are fixed to ordinary operational timezone America/Guayaquil and remain independent from Objective scheduling timezone.
Beta 1.0 uses one live SQLite read snapshot and no persistent Overview cache, eliminating invalidation races and duplicate authority.
Needs Attention ranking and narrative templates are deterministic and consume owner-classified facts only.

Communication Overview aggregation uses distinct owner-scoped SR/RFC/WFM/Objective/Spare Request/RMA/Fault Tag target refs plus the exact sealed LLD-09 CommunicationSummaryProvider; no Customer-aware authority was added to Communications.
Undefined response type aliases were removed: OverviewResponseV1 references the actual CommunicationOverviewProjectionV1 and InfrastructureOverviewProjectionV1 contracts.
Construction tests comprise 36 acceptance and 22 failure-injection cases.
The regression pass removed an empty commands registry because Overview owns no mutation surface; no audit registry is therefore required by LLD-11.

Former provider-side regression obligations are closed by the canonical cross-packet registries and hardened SIG-008 validator: LLD-01/02/03/05/06/07/08 providers and LLD-10 presentation compatibility are reconciled against one exact Overview consumer contract.
Formal Beta LLD Pass 1 and Pass 2 are both PASS; strengthened interface, route and contract-reference closure is clean on the corrected source.
design_principle: Overview summarizes one accepted-state snapshot; it may rank and explain owner facts, but it never creates, edits, guesses, caches as authority, or erases uncertainty.
